It's reasonable to expect that your contribution of half the gas would be considered as your share of the gas expenses. Additionally, you mentioned that you had used your car for the last trip of similar distance, and it was your friend's turn to provide the vehicle, which suggests that there was an understanding of sharing responsibilities and expenses. Your friend's argument that the method of acquiring the gas matters seems unfair, and it's reasonable that you wouldn't want to pay for half of the gas again.
